## HONEST NOTES / CAVEATS
- **docker-compose.yml is a skeleton.** Per your spec "Hermes wired in natively, no Dockerized Ollama" — Hermes has NO official Docker image, so it is intentionally NOT containerized (it runs native on the host, driven via Telegram). Ollama excluded per spec. The compose file has only commented examples; add real services when you decide. I did NOT fabricate a Hermes container.
- **netplan has no `priority` key** on this box — failover is done via the watchdog script, not netplan priority.
- **Do NOT enable UFW default-deny** on any node — breaks Calico pod networking. Samba is LAN-restricted via `hosts allow`.
- **HP ProDesk NotReady** = box offline/asleep, not a config fault.
